dossier.headline: Kalyan Jewellers hits upper circuit on strong Q2
dossier.summary: Kalyan Jewellers shares hit a 10% upper circuit and a 52-week high on November 11 after September-quarter consolidated profit rose 63.9% to ₹427 crore on revenue growth of about 31%. Trading volume jumped about 10-fold.
why_it_matters: One of the strongest results-driven moves of the day, leading midcap gains
watch: Whether the stock holds the upper circuit into the close
questions: What drove the jump in profit — store expansion or margins?
conflicts: An early report had the stock up about 6% at ₹649.85; a later one up 10% at ₹672.10 — different times in the session
